summary_en: ¥1,640/share (¥1,040 increase from ¥600 prior guidance) for FY3/27; 37.2% payout ratio. Revision driven by Q1 earnings beat on strong AI-related product demand and memory price strength. Company targets ¥300/share minimum dividend and 40% payout ratio by FY3/29 under mid-term plan.
title_en: Notice on Revision to Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Tomen Devices revised its dividend forecast for FY3/27 (fiscal year ending 31 March 2027) upward by ¥1,040 per share, from ¥600 to ¥1,640 per share. The revision reflects stronger-than-expected Q1 performance driven by robust demand for AI-related products and memory price strength above initial assumptions. The company expects quarterly volatility from Q2 onwards due to volume supply uncertainty and anticipated memory price stabilization, but the Q1 performance warranted an upward revision to the full-year guidance issued on 24 April 2026. The revised dividend implies a consolidated payout ratio of 37.2% for FY3/27. The company reaffirmed its mid-term plan (FY3/27–FY3/29) dividend policy, which sets a minimum dividend of ¥300 per share and targets a 40% payout ratio by FY3/29, the final year of the plan. Dividends are structured around earnings performance as a core management priority.
